record.bible_text: These <FI>are<Fi> the words<WH01697> of the covenant<WH01285>, which the LORD<WH03068> commanded<WH06680><WTH8765> Moses<WH04872> to make<WH03772><WTH8800> with the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478> in the land<WH0776> of Moab<WH04124>, beside the covenant<WH01285> which he made<WH03772><WTH8804> with them in Horeb<WH02722>.

<FI> And that<Fi> the whole land<WH0776> thereof <FI>is<Fi> brimstone<WH01614>, and salt<WH04417>, <FI>and<Fi> burning<WH08316>, <FI>that<Fi> it is not sown<WH02232><WTH8735>, nor beareth<WH06779><WTH8686>, nor any grass<WH06212> groweth<WH05927><WTH8799> therein, like the overthrow<WH04114> of Sodom<WH05467>, and Gomorrah<WH06017>, Admah<WH0126>, and Zeboim<WH06636>, which the LORD<WH03068> overthrew<WH02015><WTH8804> in his anger<WH0639>, and in his wrath<WH02534>:
